Icon Generation Instructions:

The extension needs PNG icons in the following sizes:
- icon-16.png (16x16)
- icon-32.png (32x32)
- icon-48.png (48x48)
- icon-128.png (128x128)

You can generate these from the icon.svg file using:
1. An online SVG to PNG converter
2. ImageMagick: convert -density 300 icon.svg -resize 128x128 icon-128.png
3. Or use the generate-icons.js script after installing sharp: npm install sharp

The icon design is:
- Blue rounded square background (#0EA5E9)
- White microphone icon in center
- Green checkmark badge in top-right corner

For now, the extension will work without icons, showing a default icon.
